# teams_auto_attendant (Resource)

Manages a Teams auto attendant: the greeting and key-press menu callers hear, plus the after-hours and holiday call flows. Schedules are referenced by id and managed with teams_schedule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "teams_auto_attendant" "main" {
  name         = "Main line"
  language_id  = "en-US"
  time_zone_id = "Central Standard Time"
  voice_id     = "female"

  default_call_flow {
    greeting    = "Thanks for calling Contoso."
    menu_prompt = "For sales, press 1. For support, press 2. To hear our address, press 3."
    menu_option = [
      { key = "1", action = "transfer", target_id = "6f1c2b3a-0000-4000-8000-000000000001", target_type = "user" },
      { key = "2", action = "transfer", target_id = "tel:+18005550100", target_type = "external_pstn" },
      { key = "3", action = "announcement", announcement = "We are at 1 Main Street." },
    ]
  }

  after_hours {
    schedule_id = teams_schedule.business_hours.id
    greeting    = "We are closed. Please call back during business hours."
    menu_option = [{ key = "automatic", action = "disconnect" }]
  }

  holiday {
    schedule_id = teams_schedule.holidays.id
    greeting    = "We are closed for the holiday."
    menu_option = [{ key = "automatic", action = "disconnect" }]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the auto attendant.
- `time_zone_id` (String) Windows time zone id, e.g. Central Standard Time.

### Optional

- `after_hours` (Block, Optional) Call flow used while the schedule is active. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--after_hours))
- `default_call_flow` (Block, Optional) Call flow used outside after hours and holidays. Required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--default_call_flow))
- `holiday` (Block List) Holiday call flows, in priority order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--holiday))
- `language_id` (String) Language used for text-to-speech prompts.
- `voice_id` (String) Text-to-speech voice: female or male.

### Read-Only

- `application_instances` (List of String) Resource account ids linked to the auto attendant.
- `id` (String) Auto attendant id.

<a id="nestedblock--after_hours"></a>
### Nested Schema for `after_hours`

Optional:

- `greeting` (String) Text-to-speech greeting played when the call flow starts. Conflicts with greeting_audio_file_id.
- `greeting_audio_file_id` (String) Id of a teams_audio_file (usage auto_attendant) played as the greeting. Conflicts with greeting.
- `menu_option` (Attributes List) Menu options. An automatic option must be the only one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--after_hours--menu_option))
- `menu_prompt` (String) Text-to-speech prompt describing the menu options. Conflicts with menu_prompt_audio_file_id.
- `menu_prompt_audio_file_id` (String) Id of a teams_audio_file (usage auto_attendant) played as the menu prompt. Conflicts with menu_prompt.
- `schedule_id` (String) Id of the teams_schedule that activates this call flow. Required.

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Call flow id, generated by the provider.

<a id="nestedatt--after_hours--menu_option"></a>
### Nested Schema for `after_hours.menu_option`

Required:

- `action` (String) Action: disconnect, transfer, transfer_to_operator or announcement.
- `key` (String) Key: automatic, 0-9, star or pound.

Optional:

- `announcement` (String) Text-to-speech announcement. For announcement, set this or announcement_audio_file_id.
- `announcement_audio_file_id` (String) Id of a teams_audio_file (usage auto_attendant) played as the announcement. For announcement, set this or announcement.
- `target_id` (String) Transfer target: a tel: number, a user object id or a resource account object id. Required for transfer.
- `target_type` (String) Transfer target type: user, application_endpoint, external_pstn or shared_voicemail. Required for transfer.
